title: The Calling Horn
text: An old hunter's horn rests on a cairn, its silver bands gone black. The hunters who left it say it calls any beast that hears it, every beast, from miles around. Nobody has blown it in a long while. There are claw marks on the cairn.

options.label: Blow the horn, full and loud, and let every beast come.

outcomes.text: Every beast for miles hears it. All of them come, and all of them are angry.

options.label: Take it home, unblown, for another day and another hunt.

outcomes.text: It rides home in the pack, silent for now. The claw marks on the cairn remind you what it calls.

options.label: The quietest blows it, very softly, hoping only the quarry hears.

outcomes.text: Only the quarry hears. It comes alone, curious.
